To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the expert system AGATHA (AGile Automated Test and Diagnosis of HP Advanced Technology) has successfully reduced the backlog of undi-agnosed PA-RISC processor board failures from 10 percent a month to 0.5 percent a month.

the expert system AGATHA, designed to test and diagnose the PA-RISC processor board, has been used to test 1,000 boards in the first year, and that its use has reduced the backlog of undiagnosis by 50 percent in the first year.

(1) the expert-system approach can be used effectively to test and diagnose complex electronic boards; (2) the approach can be used successfully to solve problems in the manufacturing domain; (3) the approach is effective for both testing and diagnosing problems; (4) expert systems can be developed and maintained by a team of engineers, with little need for computer scientists; (5) expert systems are most useful when they are used to augment the capabilities of human experts, rather than replace them;
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of expert systems to the problem of testing and diagnosing complex electronic boards.
the development of an integrated system to test and diagnose complex personal computer (PC) boards.
the design of a system that uses artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to test and diagnose complex boards.

the AGATHA expert system is a success.
